text: Complete strictStudio preflight with pointer/shortcut fixes passed5252tests (4385portable+867desktop),1existing opt-in private-data skip,style,boundaries. Additional unavailable-selected-report probe then reproduced a pre-existing accessibility hole: nativeToggleGroup suppresses every available scale fromTab when its selected toggle is disabled. Working correction uses ResultsFocus.scaleEntry to select a focus entry among available choices while preserving the explicitly shown scale; userSpace/Enter is required to choose a different report. Native selector is a one-stop roving group driven by that portable entry, with explicit selected styling. PureJVM/JS and affected94desktop checks running in implementation. No new source freeze/landing yet; release2 remains intentionally incomplete/superseded.
